title: Local-first todo application
summary: Deliver an offline todo application with persistence, filters, safe JSON import, and a privacy notice.
assumptions: The browser supports localStorage and the File API.
T1 is the 1-unit reference. Other values are rough workload ratios including implementation, tests, review, and merge work.
risks: This example assumes privacy review readiness at T+4. Dependent tasks still wait if the condition is unmet; this is not a calendar commitment.
Unusually large import files may affect browser responsiveness.

requirements.text: Create, complete, and delete todo items with local persistence.
Filter todo items by completion status.
Safely import JSON without damaging existing data on errors.
Provide a privacy review and an explanation of local data storage.

tasks.title: Define the data contract
tasks.description: Define the todo entity, storage version, and import format.
acceptance: Fields and migration rules have tests
tasks.estimate_basis: Small contract design, unit tests, and review
tasks.pr_scope: Data types, validators, and contract tests only

tasks.title: Implement local storage
tasks.description: Implement creation, completion, deletion, and localStorage persistence.
acceptance: Creation, completion, and deletion tests pass
tasks.estimate_basis: Adapter implementation, migration tests, and review
tasks.pr_scope: Storage layer and its tests, without UI

tasks.title: Build the list and filters
tasks.description: Use the frozen T1 contract and an in-memory mock to implement creation, completion, deletion, and three filters, making the UI PR independently reviewable and mergeable.
acceptance: Creation, completion, and deletion work independently with the mock
tasks.estimate_basis: Components, interaction tests, accessibility checks, and review
tasks.pr_scope: List and filter UI without changing the storage contract

tasks.title: Implement JSON import
tasks.description: Validate the complete file before writing the data transactionally.
tasks.estimate_basis: File reading, validation, rollback tests, and review
tasks.pr_scope: Import service, entry point, and error handling

tasks.title: External privacy review
tasks.description: An external team confirms the local-data notice and browser storage usage.
tasks.estimate_basis: External readiness at T+4 is a scenario assumption, not a calendar promise
tasks.pr_scope: No code PR; record the external conclusion

tasks.title: Add the privacy notice
tasks.description: Integrate an in-product privacy notice based on the external review.
acceptance: Copy agrees with the review conclusion
tasks.estimate_basis: Copy integration, UI tests, and review
tasks.pr_scope: Privacy notice page and entry point

tasks.title: Complete end-to-end acceptance
tasks.description: Connect the T3 UI to the T2 real storage adapter and cover storage, filters, import, and the privacy notice.
acceptance: The UI uses real storage for creation, refresh, completion, and deletion
tasks.estimate_basis: End-to-end execution, defect verification, and review
tasks.pr_scope: UI-to-storage integration, end-to-end tests, and release checks

tasks.title: Release readiness
tasks.description: Release milestone after all acceptance work is complete.
